evidence_boundaries: The Tavana paper directly measures electron spectra and angles, activation products, photon angular signatures, and bubble-detector neutron doses; spectral reconstruction, peak flux, positron production, and converter optimization include inverse-model or GEANT4 assumptions.

The Babjak pair and muon source is a quasi-3D PIC to Geant4 to two-dimensional PIC feasibility chain; no pair or muon experiment is reported, and total positron count does not by itself meet narrow-band injector requirements.
The Luo paper is an NLTE double-Maxwellian reanalysis of historical Nova spectra; the inferred local suprathermal number fraction is not the same observable as globally collected SRS power loss.
The formal Shenguang pure-deuterium implosion paper was not added because no validated lawful full text was obtained; it remains a retry candidate.
No OSIRIS, Geant4, FAC, spectral inversion, or raw experimental analysis was rerun locally.
